# Hire1Percent

> AI-powered technical recruitment platform combining resume intelligence, proctored coding assessments, and asynchronous video interviews into a unified pipeline.

Hire1Percent reduces manual engineering hiring overhead by unifying resume screening, candidate-to-role skill alignment, code evaluation, session integrity tracking, and structured asynchronous interviews. Evaluator signals are human-in-the-loop decision aids, not automated hiring decisions.

## Primary Documentation
- [System Architecture](https://www.hire1percent.com/#system): End-to-end overview of candidate intake, sandboxed code execution, and recruiter dashboards.
- [AI Resume Parsing](https://www.hire1percent.com/#parsing): Semantic skill extraction, role alignment scoring, and resume noise reduction.
- [Assessment & Proctoring](https://www.hire1percent.com/#proctoring): Sandboxed multi-language coding assessments and session integrity monitoring (tab-switching, focus changes).
- [Asynchronous Video Interviews](https://www.hire1percent.com/#interviews): Structured technical and communication evaluation without live scheduling friction.
- [Audit & Recruiter Intelligence](https://www.hire1percent.com/#audit): Consolidated candidate records, assessment logs, and reviewable integrity signals.

## Optional & Resources
- [Full LLM Context](https://www.hire1percent.com/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation corpus for deep RAG ingestion.
- [Platform Integrations](https://www.hire1percent.com/#integrations): Workflow compatibility with existing ATS and enterprise hiring stacks.
